newsitem.title: USA: Star Gas in talks on sale or merger.
newsitem.headline: Star Gas in talks on sale or merger.

text.p: Star Gas Partners LP said on Thursday it was in talks with parties who have expressed an interest in either buying or merging with Star.
In August Star hired Stanley & Co Inc to review strategic alternatives, including a possible sale or merger.

"To date, we have received indications of interest from a number of potential acquirers and merger partners and are pursuing discussions with them," the company said in its earnings announcement released Thursday.

"Given the Partnership's attractive customer profile, its concentration in two high-margin geographic areas, its reorganized and highly efficient operating structure, as well as its attractive tax characteristics, we believe that Star Gas has a premium value not fully reflected in the marketplace," it said.
Shares of Star Gas closed at 22-3/8 on Wednesday.
Petroleum Heat & Power Inc owns a stake in Star Gas.
